description: This file defines a Java class 'ConfigDefinition' responsible for processing configuration files, generating code artifacts, and managing configuration structures within a software project. It includes methods for parsing configuration scripts, handling different structural blocks, and generating output templates.

classes.name: ConfigDefinition
classes.description: Main class responsible for configuration file processing, code generation, and parsing logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the program, processes command-line arguments, reads input files, and initiates processing.

methods.name: processTextTemplate
methods.description: Reads an input template file, applies variable substitutions, and writes the processed output to a destination file.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Core method to read and interpret configuration script lines, managing structure blocks, definitions, and comments.

methods.name: handleCustomLine
methods.description: Processes custom configuration lines specifying tuner settings or other custom parameters.

methods.name: handleBitLine
methods.description: Handles 'bit' configuration lines, creating bit fields within structures.

methods.name: startsWithToken
methods.description: Utility to check if a line starts with a specific token followed by whitespace or tab.

methods.name: handleStartStructure
methods.description: Begins processing a new structure definition, pushing it onto the stack.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Ends processing of a structure, finalizes it, and passes it to consumers.

methods.name: processField
methods.description: Parses a line representing a configuration field and adds it to the current structure.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Generates formatted comment strings with offset information.

methods.name: packComment
methods.description: Segments a comment string into multiple lines with a prefix for formatting.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a variable or integer value based on predefined variable registry.

methods.name: processDefine
methods.description: Handles '#define' directives, registering them into the variable registry.
